entities.name: Lison–Lamballe railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Lison–Lamballe railway is an important 205.7-kilometre long railway line that runs between the French commune of Lison and the town of Lamballe. It is used for passenger and freight traffic. The railway was opened in several stages between 1860 and 1879.
